Layer.UpdateCommand: %function(self) local songg = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() local coursee = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentCourse() if songg then self:settext(ReplaceSpaceWithLineBreaks(songg:GetDisplayMainTitle(), 10)) local Theight = self:GetHeight() if Theight > 400 then self:zoom(0.95*(400/Theight)) end elseif coursee then self:settext(ReplaceSpaceWithLineBreaks(coursee:GetDisplayFullTitle(), 10)) end self:queuecommand('Anim') end

%function(self) if GAMESTATE:IsCourseMode() then self:settext('- SONG 1 -') elseif not GAMESTATE:IsEventMode() then if IsExtraStage() or IsExtraStage2() then self:settext('- STAGE EXTRA -') elseif IsFinalStage() then self:settext('- STAGE FINAL -') else self:settext('- STAGE ' .. GAMESTATE:StageIndex()+1 .. ' -') end end end
